#### 1. Introduction

The Seagate® FireCuda® 530R SSD is a versatile NVMe SSD with PCIe Gen4 x4 interface. It is up to 13x faster than SATA SSDs and delivers ultra-fast performance and enhanced endurance for long term use. Table 1 The FireCuda 530R SSD Features

| Feature | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Capacity (User) |  1000GB, 2000GB, 4000GB | |
| Certifications, Eco-Compliance |  CE, UL, FCC, BSMI, KCC, Microsoft WHQL, VCCI, CB  RoHS | |
| Dimensions | 1000GB  Length, Max 80.15mm  Width, Max 22.15mm  Height, Max 2.23mm 2000GB, 4000GB  Length, Max 80.15mm  Width, Max 22.15mm  Height, Max 3.58mm With heatsink  Length, Max 80.85mm  Width, Max 24.22mm  Height, Max 11.10mm | |
| Form Factor |  M2 2280-S2-M  M2 2280-D2-M | |
| Weight |  1000GB: 7.3g  2000GB: 8.8g  4000GB: 9.2g With heatsink  49g (max) | |
| Endurance | Total Bytes Written  1000GB: 1100TB  2000GB: 2400TB  4000GB: 5050TB | See Section 2.5, Reliability/Endurance. |
| Interface Compliance |  NVMe 1.4  PCI Express Base 4.0, PCIe Gen 4 x 4 lane, and backward compatible to PCIe Gen3, Gen 2, and Gen 1 | |
| NAND |  TLC | |
| Operating Systems |  Windows 11  Windows 10 (64 bit)  Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04  CentOS 7, 8 | |
| Performance Random |  Read: Up to 1,300,000 IOPS  Write: Up to 1,300,000 IOPS | Actual performance might vary depending on use conditions and environment. See Section 2.2, Performance. |
| Performance Sequential |  Read: Up to 7400MB/s  Write: Up to 7000MB/s | Actual performance might vary depending on the capacity, use conditions and environment. See Section 2.2, Performance. |

##### 9.3 Heatsink Disclosures

NOTE About Heatsink SSDs.  Heatsinks are pre-installed. Do not remove the heatsink; you can damage the SSD.  Dimensions exceed standard size specifications for the M.2 without a heatsink. Please verify that your system has enough space for installation.  SSDs with heatsinks are recommended for M.2 with connectors H3.2 and above.

Highlights:
## Seagate FireCuda 530R SSD with Heatsink

Usher in a new era of domination. FireCuda 530R SSD with Heatsink, the latest evolution of our best-selling PCIe Gen4 SSD, unleashes ultra-fast speeds, extreme durability, and unrivalled performance. With leading-edge components in a slim M.2 2280 form factor and built-in heatsink, it’s ideal for pro-level gamers and creators. FireCuda 530R SSD supports Microsoft™ DirectStorage, and is PS5™ compatible for seamless gaming. Plus, it’s available in 1TB, 2TB, or 4TB capacities.

...

1 Using an M.2 SSD with your PS5 console requires effective heat dissipation with a cooling structure, such as an heatsink and a heat transfer sheet.

...
